pages.text: IT SEEMS THEY ARE INVESTIGATING ABOUT THE GHOUL CALLED "TORSO"...

pages.text: "Torso" is estimated to be a dangerous A rate ghoul...

pages.text: EVEN THOUGH THOSE INEXPERIENCED TWO SHOULD BE BEHAVING MODESTLY...

pages.text: WERE YOU ABLE TO GET IN TOUCH WITH THOSE TWO?

pages.text: LET'S GO GET THE INVESTIGATION DATA

pages.text: UMM... I GREETED HER WHEN I WAS LEAVING BUT...

pages.text: IT SEEMS SHE WAS UP LATE LAST NIGHT...

pages.text: I UNDERSTAND... WHEN I GET BACK I'LL GIVE HER A LECTURE.

pages.text: is taking my best efforts just to unify the team

pages.text: YOU GUYS AREN'T RESPONSIBLE FOR TORSO, ARE YOU?

pages.text: I UNDERSTAND THAT YOU'RE GETTING DESPERATE

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: BECAUSE HIRAKO'S SQUAD HAS A BIG LEAD ON YOU

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: BUT I REALLY WONDER ABOUT YOU GOING SO FAR

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: AS TO SNATCH UP ANOTHER GROUP'S JOB...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IT WILL BE DANGEROUS IF THE NEWCOMERS WERE TO HAVE A STANDOFF WITH THE TARGET GHOUL...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I MUST GO AHEAD AND STOP THEM EVEN MORE THAN I'D HAVE TO GO FOR A SUBORDINATE...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: WE HAVE OUR OWN WAY OF DOING THINGS, SO PLEASE GIVE UP.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: ...OR PERHAPS I SHOULD SAY, RANK 1 SASAKI, WAS IT?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: THE SOURCE OF ALL THIS FROM THE START WAS

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: THAT YOU COULDN'T CONTROL YOUR SUBORDINATES, WASN'T IT?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: AND WITH THAT REASON DEMANDING "HAND OVER YOUR DATA"...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: IS NOTHING MORE THAN TYRANNY, DON'T YOU THINK?

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: SENSEI... LET'S GO ALREADY... WE DON'T HAVE TIME FOR...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IT'S JUST AS YOU SAID; I MISMANAGED CONTROL...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I AGREE THAT TELLING YOU TO FREELY SHOW ME YOUR

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: PRECIOUS DATA CAN ONLY BE CALLED TYRANNICAL...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I DO NOT WANT TO EXPOSE MY SUBORDINATES TO DANGER DUE TO MY CARELESSNESS...!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IF WE MAKE AN ACHIEVEMENT THEN WE WILL HAND THAT OVER TO YOU.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IF YOU'D JUST GIVE US THE DATA...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: DID YOU THINK IT'D TURN OUT ALRIGHT IF YOU JUST BOWED YOUR HEAD...?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: HOW TROUBLESOME. DOING THINGS LIKE THIS...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: IS THAT SORT OF THING FITTING FOR A GHOUL INVESTIGATOR?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: LISTEN TO ME. YOU, ALL OF YOU GUYS,

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: EVEN IF IT WERE A HUMAN THAT'S AN "UPRIGHT INVESTIGATOR" DOING THIS SORT OF THING,

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: GUYS WHO TRY TO SHOW OFF, BOW DOWN AND GET REFUSED ARE SO LAME...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: NO... THERE'S NO WAY I'D THINK THAT...!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: ...EVEN IF WE DON'T HAVE THE DATA,

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: This is no time to be ashamed.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: HEADQUARTERS SHOULD HAVE THE INVESTIGATION'S PROGRESS REPORTS.

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: TO THE COMMISSION OF COUNTER-GHOUL, PLEASE.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: TO THINK YOU'D HAVE SOME BUSINESS AT SUCH A PLACE EVEN THOUGH YOU'RE SO YOUNG...

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: ... (HE IGNORED ME...? MAN, KIDS THESE DAYS...)

pages.text: Soon I'll have exhausted my funds.

pages.text: IF PUSH COMES TO SHOVE, SHOULD I JUST RIDE FOR FREE UNDER THE PRETEXT OF AN INVESTIGATION?

pages.text: I MAKE THINGS LIKE CREAM PUFFS IN THE OVEN.

pages.text: THAT FLUFFY AND FLAKY TEXTURE, AND THAT WHIP CREAM SPILLING OUT.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: STUFFING YOUR MOUTH WITH THE PIPING HOT ONES RIGHT OUT OF THE OVEN IS SUPREME BLISS.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: TODAY, I MADE SOME FOR LUNCH TOO.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I DO WHENEVER I HAVE SOME FREE TIME.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I'M SURPRISINGLY ADDICTED TO IT. IT CALMS ME DOWN SOMEHOW.

pages.text: I'M GOING TO FINISH HIM OFF.

pages.text: "DO NOT INFLICT MORE PAIN THAN NECESSARY" IS A PART OF THE GHOUL COUNTERMEASURES CODE, ISN'T IT?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: AND WE ALSO MIGHT BE ABLE TO GET INFORMATION OUT OF HIM...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I TOLD YOU NOT TO TAKE ACTION ON YOUR OWN, DIDN'T I...!?

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: FOR ARGUMENT'S SAKE, EVEN IF WE DO GET HIT, WE'LL HEAL SOONER OR LATER ANYHOW, RIGHT?

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: THOUGH IN MY CASE, THAT'D TAKE SOME TIME.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: THEN GHOULS WILL NEVER BE ELIMINATED FROM THIS WORLD.

pages.text: THE QUINX HAVE "EXPERIMENTAL BODIES" SO TO SPEAK.

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: THEY ARE HUMANS WHO HAD THEIR NATURAL ENEMY'S "GHOUL POWER" INSERTED INTO THEM.

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: AND THE ONE LEADING THEM IS-

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: the ghoul named Kobayashi who Rank 2 Urie had suspected of being "Torso" and faced off against...

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: ABSORBED IN THE ADMIRATION OF HIS "HARVEST".

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: YOUR WOUNDS WILL OPEN BACK UP!

pages.text: HE WAS PROBABLY ONE OF THE TOP TWO PHYSICIANS IN KYOTO.

pages.speaker: character4
pages.text: HE SAID YOUR FIGHTING DAYS ARE OVER.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: MASTER CAN'T USE A SWORD ANYMORE ...

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: IT SEEMS LIKE THEY'RE NOT SURE IF HE'LL BE ABLE TO WALK EVER AGAIN.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: OTSU, YOU PROBABLY DON'T UNDERSTAND BECAUSE YOU'RE A WOMAN,

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: BUT MASTER WAS BORN FOR THE SWORD.

pages.text: HE'D BE BETTER OFF IF HE'D DIED IN BATTLE!

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: AH, TARO WHERE ARE YOU GOING?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: He'd be better off if he'd died.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: THE FASTEST WAY FOR ME TO RISE IN THE RANKS OF THE MARTIAL ARTS MASTERS AT THIS POINT IN TIME...

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: HOW MUCH LONGER WILL THAT MAN BE HERE...?

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: I WOULD BE GRATEFUL IF HE LEFT AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: WE CANNOT ALLOW SOMEONE WHO HAS SLAIN SO MANY MEN TO STAY HERE FOR FOREVER.

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: MUSTN'T WE, AS FOLLOWERS OF BUDDHA,

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: NO, ESPECIALLY BECAUSE HE IS A CRIMINAL?

pages.speaker: character2
pages.text: IMPATIENCE WON'T GET YOU WALKING AGAIN.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: OH, WORKING HARD THERE, OTSU? BE CAREFUL ...

pages.text: IT WAS DELICIOUS. A bit salty though...

pages.text: A SINGLE STROKE OF THE SWORD WITH EVERYTHING HE HAD FROM BEHIND...

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: EVEN THE YOSHIOKA COULDN'T CARE ABOUT HOW THEY LOOK TO OTHERS.

pages.text: STAY HERE A WHILE AND RECUPERATE.
